description: Send qed.bot a link it should look at: a paper, a repository, a post or an announcement of AI work in mathematics, with an optional note, and no record to choose. A link already waiting as a lead is returned rather than sent twice. Needs an API key, free from https://qed.bot/check, sent as Authorization: Bearer qed_.... It goes to review: nothing in the register changes until an administrator accepts it in public, and grades are never bought. Returns the submission's id; poll get_submission with it.

note.description: What it shows and why the register should hold it, at most 2000 characters

title.description: Optional, at most 160 characters; the link's host and path by default

name: submit_lead
